notice: Targets and expected digests only; this file does not assert that any registry reference has been uploaded or made public.

source_audit_object_set_digest.canonicalization: Not encoded in the source roster; retained as an opaque authority/audit provenance value.

reproducible_object_set_digest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 RFC 8259 JSON for the objects described below, projected to archive_sha256, archive_size_bytes, archive_path, task_aliases, oci_top_index_digest, and linux_amd64_manifest_digest; array sorted by archive_sha256; object keys sorted; separators are comma and colon; no trailing newline.

oci_parse.method: For each unique gzip OCI layout, extract blobs/sha256/<top-index-digest>; verify the blob bytes hash to that digest; select the single descriptor with platform os=linux and architecture=amd64; cross-check both digests against the corresponding frozen task build record.
